title: L’Oréal and Aster Pharmacy introduce in-store beauty refills in the UAE
excerpt: L’Oréal and Aster Pharmacy announced a UAE refill partnership, beginning with selected stores and a phased rollout through 2027.
body:
L’Oréal Middle East and Aster Pharmacy announced a partnership on 5 November 2026 to introduce in-store refill options in the UAE. The announcement names La Roche-Posay, Vichy and CeraVe among the brands involved. The rollout is planned in phases, with the first installations expected in ten Aster Pharmacy stores and further expansion through 2027.

The initiative is part of a wider effort to make refill formats available through retail. The announcement does not provide a final list of participating locations or a complete schedule, so customers should check directly with Aster before visiting.

For beauty businesses, the development is a useful reminder that customers increasingly encounter refill formats across different parts of their routine. Product availability and participation remain retailer-specific.

Source: L’Oréal Middle East and Aster Pharmacy announcement, 5 November 2026, via Zawya.

title: Keratin treatment or hair Botox: questions to ask before booking
excerpt: The names do not describe one universal formula. Use your consultation to understand the product, finish and aftercare before choosing.
body:
Searching for a keratin treatment or hair Botox in Dubai can bring up similar promises, but the names alone do not tell you exactly what a salon will apply. Hair Botox is a marketing term used for different conditioning services, not one standard formula. Keratin services also vary by product and technique.

Start with the result you want

Bring a clear reference and explain what you want your hair to look and feel like. Tell the stylist about previous colour, lightening or chemical services. A consultation helps the professional decide whether the requested service suits your hair and expectations.

Ask what is in the service

Before booking, ask for the product name, ingredient information and the manufacturer’s directions. Ask whether the service changes your natural texture, how heat is used and what finish to expect. If you have sensitivities, ask to review the product information and discuss them with the salon before the appointment.

Understand the aftercare

Ask when you can wash or tie your hair and which care instructions apply to that specific product. These details can differ, so follow the stylist’s and manufacturer’s directions rather than a general rule from social media.

For a keratin treatment in Dubai or a hair Botox consultation at a salon in Al Barsha, choose based on a transparent conversation about the product and your hair history, not the service name alone.

title: A few simple ways to care for a salon blow-dry
excerpt: A gentle cool-down, low-friction sleep and less unnecessary brushing can help keep a fresh blow-dry looking neat.
tip1: Let hair cool completely before brushing or tying it up. Cooling helps the finished shape settle.
tip2: At bedtime, use a loose style that does not pull at the roots. A soft scrunchie can reduce creasing.
tip3: Avoid repeatedly running your hands through the hair. Friction and oils can disturb the finish.
tip4: If humidity affects your style, ask your stylist which finishing product suits your hair and the look you want.
tip5: Refresh only the areas that need it with low heat and a heat protectant used according to its label.

title: Beautyworld Dubai 2026 reports 62,130 visitors at its 30th edition
excerpt: The event organiser reported 62,130 visitors and business activity valued at $1.19 billion for the October 2026 show.
body:
Beautyworld Middle East’s organiser, Messe Frankfurt Middle East, reported that the 30th edition of Beautyworld Dubai welcomed 62,130 visitors in October 2026. The organiser said 42% of attendees came from outside the UAE and reported business activity valued at $1.19 billion.

These figures are attributed to the event organiser and should be read as its post-event reporting. The release describes a large regional meeting point for beauty, hair and wellness businesses, with exhibitors and visitors from international markets.

The next edition is scheduled for 12 to 14 October 2027 at Dubai World Trade Centre, according to the organiser.

Source: Messe Frankfurt Middle East, Beautyworld Dubai post-show release.

title: Balayage or highlights: how to choose your next colour appointment
excerpt: The right choice depends on the finish you like, your starting colour and how much upkeep you want to discuss with your colourist.
body:
Balayage and highlights are both ways to add dimension to hair, but they can create different patterns and finishes. The result depends on your starting colour, hair history, placement and the colourist’s technique. A consultation is the best place to decide what fits your hair.

What you want to see in the mirror

Bring reference photos taken in natural light. Point out what you like in each image, such as where the lighter pieces begin or how much contrast you want. A photo is a guide, not a guarantee, because hair colour and previous treatments affect the result.

Talk about upkeep

Ask how the proposed placement may grow out on your hair and what maintenance the colourist recommends. If you prefer a softer transition, say so. If you want brighter pieces near the face or a more even pattern, make that clear during the consultation.

Share your hair history

Tell the colourist about previous colour, box dye, lightening and chemical treatments. This helps them assess the starting point and discuss what is realistic in one appointment.

When comparing balayage in Dubai with traditional highlights, focus on the look you want and the plan your colourist proposes for your hair, rather than choosing by trend name alone.

title: Gentle habits for salon hair extensions
excerpt: Use the care method recommended for your extension type and ask your stylist when to return for maintenance.
tip1: Use the detangling method your stylist demonstrated for your specific extension type.
tip2: Work gently from the ends upward and support the hair near the attachment area while detangling.
tip3: Follow the product and washing instructions provided by your stylist. Attachment methods can have different care needs.
tip4: Avoid sleeping with wet hair or extensions unless your stylist has advised a specific routine.
tip5: Book a maintenance check when recommended, and contact the salon if an attachment feels uncomfortable or slips.

title: New report projects continued growth for the GCC beauty market
excerpt: A report commissioned by Messe Frankfurt estimates the GCC beauty market at $14.3 billion in 2025 and projects growth by 2030.
body:
A Beautyworld Middle East report commissioned by Messe Frankfurt Middle East estimates the GCC beauty market at $14.3 billion in 2025 and projects it could approach $21 billion by 2030.

The figures are market estimates and forward-looking projections, not confirmed future results. The report covers the wider beauty market across the Gulf Cooperation Council, so the estimate should not be read as a Dubai-only figure or as a forecast for any single salon.

The report points to a regional market shaped by retail, services and consumer spending. Its projections offer context for businesses, while actual outcomes will depend on market conditions and consumer behaviour.

Source: Messe Frankfurt Middle East, GCC beauty market report announcement.

title: Clip-in, tape-in or stitched extensions: what to ask your stylist
excerpt: Understand the consultation questions that help match an extension method to your hair, styling habits and maintenance needs.
body:
Clip-in, tape-in and stitched extensions are different approaches to adding length or fullness. The most suitable option depends on your hair, desired result, daily routine and the stylist’s assessment. A method should not be chosen from a photo alone.

Ask how the method is applied

Have the stylist explain where the extensions will sit, how they are fitted and how removal works. Ask what you will feel during wear and what to do if an attachment becomes uncomfortable.

Discuss your routine

Tell the stylist how often you wash and heat-style your hair, how you wear it for work or exercise and how much time you want to spend on care. Ask which method fits that routine and what aftercare it requires.

Get a maintenance plan

Before booking, ask how follow-up appointments are handled and what signs mean you should contact the salon sooner. Do not assume all methods share the same maintenance schedule.

If you are considering hair extensions in Dubai, bring your questions to an in-person consultation. A stylist can check your hair and explain the options available at the salon.

title: Keep a gel manicure neat between salon visits
excerpt: Protect the finish with gentle daily care and let a nail professional remove gel polish rather than peeling it off.
tip1: Do not pick or peel lifting gel. Contact a nail professional for advice on safe removal.
tip2: Apply cuticle oil to the surrounding skin as part of your regular hand-care routine.
tip3: Wear gloves for household cleaning to limit prolonged contact with detergents and water.
tip4: Avoid using your nails as tools, which can place stress on the polish and natural nail.
tip5: Tell your nail technician if you notice persistent discomfort or a change in the nail, and seek appropriate professional advice.

title: Dubai Municipality highlights its Model Salon Initiative at Beautyworld
excerpt: Dubai Municipality used Beautyworld Dubai 2026 to highlight its Model Salon Initiative and recognise selected beauty establishments.
body:
Dubai Municipality said it took part in Beautyworld Dubai 2026 to present its Model Salon Initiative. In an update dated 6 October, the municipality said the initiative recognises selected salons and beauty centres for meeting health and safety requirements.

The announcement describes a municipal programme and does not state that every salon in Dubai is included. It also does not identify Layali Al Zahra Beauty Lounge as a recognised establishment. Customers can contact the municipality or a salon directly if they need to verify a specific licence or recognition.

The initiative places attention on standards and compliance in the beauty sector. Its details should be checked through official municipal channels as the programme develops.

title: How to plan a bridal hair trial in Dubai
excerpt: A clear reference, your accessories and an honest conversation help make a bridal hair trial more useful.
body:
A bridal hair trial gives you and your stylist time to discuss the look before the wedding day. It is also a chance to see how your hair and accessories work together. The plan should reflect your venue, outfit and personal preference.

Bring useful references

Save a few images that show the shape and finish you like. Include examples of what you do not want if that is easier to explain. Photos help start the conversation, but your hair length, texture and previous services affect what can be achieved.

Bring the details that change the look

If you plan to wear a veil, headpiece or hair jewellery, bring it to the trial or share a clear photo. Tell the stylist about your outfit neckline and the event setting. These details can affect where the style sits and how it is secured.

Talk about the day itself

Share the ceremony timing, location and any changes between venues. Ask how the style can be refreshed and what products or accessories will be used. If you have sensitivities, mention them before the appointment.

For bridal hairstyling in Dubai, ask the salon about trial availability and booking details directly so your plan matches the date and service schedule.

title: Makeup touch-ups for a humid day
excerpt: A light hand and a small touch-up kit can help refresh makeup without repeatedly layering product.
tip1: Apply complexion products in thin layers and allow each layer to settle before adding more.
tip2: Before powdering shine, gently blot the area with a clean tissue or blotting paper.
tip3: Carry only the products needed to refresh the look, such as lipstick or the shade used on the cheeks.
tip4: Try your event makeup in advance so you can see how the products wear on your skin.
tip5: Use sunscreen according to its label and reapply as directed. Do not rely on makeup alone for sun protection.

title: Unilever says hair care growth accelerated in its third-quarter results
excerpt: Unilever reported stronger Hair Care growth in Q3 2026, citing demand for products including serums and masks.
body:
Unilever said its Hair Care business accelerated in the third quarter of 2026, with double-digit growth, in its company results commentary. The company attributed growth in part to Dove and demand for products including serums and masks.

This is Unilever’s reporting about its own business and portfolio. It is not an independent measure of the overall hair-care market, and the company’s reported results should not be treated as a forecast for salons or other brands.

The update offers a snapshot of one major consumer-goods company’s performance. It also shows how product launches and category reporting can shape the way large beauty businesses describe growth.

title: Colour-treated hair: care questions to ask your stylist
excerpt: Aftercare depends on the colour service and your hair. Ask your colourist for a routine that fits the products used.
body:
After a colour appointment, the most useful aftercare advice is the advice that matches your service and hair. Colour products, hair condition and home routines vary, so ask your colourist for specific instructions before you leave.

Ask when to wash

Ask when to shampoo after your appointment and whether the colourist recommends any change to your usual routine. Follow the product directions they provide rather than assuming one timing works for every service.

Choose products with your colourist

Ask whether your current shampoo and conditioner suit your colour service. If you use a treatment mask or scalp product, mention it so the stylist can advise whether it fits the routine they recommend.

Be thoughtful with heat styling

Frequent high heat can affect the feel and appearance of hair. Use a heat protectant according to its label and choose a temperature appropriate for your hair. Ask the salon for advice if your hair feels unusually dry or fragile after colouring.

When booking hair colour in Dubai, mention your past services and ask for aftercare instructions tailored to the colour plan discussed with your stylist.

title: Before your eyebrow threading appointment
excerpt: Arrive with clean skin and tell your therapist about any sensitivity or products that may affect the brow area.
tip1: Arrive with the brow area clean, and avoid applying heavy makeup immediately before your appointment.
tip2: Tell your therapist if your skin is sensitive or currently irritated around the brow area.
tip3: Mention any topical products or recent treatments you use near the brows so the therapist can advise on suitability.
tip4: Share your preferred shape and how much you want removed before the service begins.
tip5: If you are unsure whether threading is suitable for you, contact the salon before booking and ask for guidance.
